body:
Interstellar Communication Resilience Engine. Designs store-and-forward information networks that remain useful despite enormous transmission delays.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 68 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Stellar and Interstellar Expansion". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. DTN is proven interplanetary; interstellar resilience is the extension.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Interstellar Communication Resilience Engine - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Designs store-and-forward information networks that remain useful despite enormous transmission delays.
body:
Known science foundations of Interstellar Communication Resilience Engine.

Bundle Protocol DTN flies. Deep-space optical comms advance. Designing for year-long delays — custody, redundancy, autonomy — extends proven tech.

Key quantity check (Longest DTN delay tested in days / interstellar delay in days): computed ratio 0.243333 against the reference value, relative error 0.001372, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Interstellar Communication Resilience Engine - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Designs store-and-forward information networks that remain useful despite enormous transmission delays.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Interstellar Communication Resilience Engine.

Delays of years break interactivity. Bandwidth is tiny. No interstellar nodes exist.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 3.18 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is interstellar vs throughput at 3.18 orders of magnitude (interstellar larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
